name: instagram-data-mcp

tools.name: instagram_profile
tools.description:
Get an Instagram profile. Follower, following and post counts, bio, links, category, verification and the profile picture of any public account.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_user_id
tools.description:
Instagram username to user id. The numeric user id for a handle. Every endpoint also accepts either one directly, so you rarely need this.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_username
tools.description:
Instagram user id to username. The current handle for a numeric user id, which still works after the account renames itself.

Cost: 2 credits.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_check
tools.description:
Check if an Instagram handle exists and is public. Does this handle exist, and is it public? States: ok, not_found, private, deactivated, memorialized, age_restricted, restricted_minor. Exact match only, so a typo never resolves to someone else.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

tools.name: instagram_posts
tools.description:
Get recent Instagram posts. 12 posts per page, newest first, with likes, comments, views, caption and media URLs. Page with cursor.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_reels
tools.description:
Get an account's Instagram reels. The reels tab of a public account: play counts, likes, comments, captions and video URLs. Page with cursor.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_tagged
tools.description:
Get posts an account is tagged in. Public posts by other accounts that tag this account.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_post
tools.description:
Get one Instagram post or reel. Likes, comments, views, caption, owner and media URLs for a single post, reel or IGTV video.

Cost: 1 credit.

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

shortcode.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).

tools.name: instagram_media
tools.description:
Download URLs for a post, reel or carousel. Direct image and video file URLs for every slide of a post, in the best quality available. URLs are signed Instagram CDN links that expire after a few hours.

Cost: 1 credit.

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

shortcode.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).

tools.name: instagram_comments
tools.description:
Get comments on an Instagram post. The top comments on a post with author, text, time, likes and reply count, plus the total comment count.

Cost: 3 credits.

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

shortcode.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).

tools.name: instagram_comment_replies
tools.description:
Get replies to an Instagram comment. Replies under one comment. Page with cursor.

Cost: 3 credits.

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

shortcode.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_likers
tools.description:
Get accounts that liked an Instagram post. A sample of accounts that liked a public post, plus the total like count. One page per call with no cursor, so it is not the full list of likers.

Cost: 3 credits.

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

shortcode.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).

tools.name: instagram_insights
tools.description:
Instagram engagement rate calculator. Engagement rate (mean and median), posting cadence, format mix, best posting hours (UTC) and a percentile against the Instagram Benchmarks report, from the latest 12 posts. Pinned posts are excluded.

Cost: 2 credits.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_followers
tools.description:
Get an account's followers. One page of the accounts that follow a public account, with the total follower count. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; null means no more pages are available. Private accounts return 422 private_account.

Cost: 3 credits.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_following
tools.description:
Get accounts an account follows. One page of the accounts a public account follows, with the total. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; null means no more pages are available. Private accounts return 422 private_account.

Cost: 3 credits.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_similar
tools.description:
Find similar Instagram accounts. Accounts Instagram considers related to this one.

Cost: 1 credit.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_stories
tools.description:
View Instagram stories anonymously. Stories posted in the last 24 hours by a public account, with image and video URLs. Signed CDN links that expire after a few hours.

Cost: 3 credits.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_highlights
tools.description:
Get Instagram story highlights. Title, cover image and item count for each highlight. Pass an id to /v1/highlight for its items.

Cost: 3 credits.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

user_id.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

tools.name: instagram_highlight
tools.description:
Get the items in one highlight. Every photo and video inside one highlight, with signed CDN URLs. Costs 3 credits the first time for an account; more highlights of the same account are free for 15 minutes.

Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: instagram_search
tools.description:
Search Instagram accounts, hashtags and places. Matching accounts, hashtags (with post counts) and places (with location ids).

Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: instagram_hashtag
tools.description:
Get posts for an Instagram hashtag. Recent posts under a hashtag and its total post count. Page with cursor.

Cost: 1 credit.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_place
tools.description:
Get an Instagram location. Name, category, address, city, phone, website and post count of a location page. Find ids with /v1/search.

Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: instagram_place_posts
tools.description:
Get posts tagged at an Instagram location. Recent posts geotagged at a location. Page with cursor.

Cost: 1 credit.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_audio
tools.description:
Get an Instagram audio track and the reels using it. Title, artist, duration and a preview URL for an original sound or song, plus reels that use it. Audio ids come from reels.

Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: instagram_audio_search
tools.description:
Search Instagram music and sounds. Find songs and sounds by title or artist, with ids you can pass to /v1/audio.

Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: instagram_reels_search
tools.description:
Search Instagram reels by keyword. Reels matching a keyword. Page with cursor.

Cost: 3 credits.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

tools.name: instagram_top_accounts
tools.description:
Most-followed Instagram accounts, gainers and losers. The same data as fastsocial.co/most-followed-instagram-accounts (Instagram Top Charts): the biggest notable public Instagram accounts ranked by followers, updated daily, with 1, 7 and 30-day follower changes, country, category and projected milestones. Free (0 credits); needs any API key. Data CC BY 4.0: credit FastSocial and link the source.

Cost: 0 credits.

sort.description: followers = biggest accounts; gainers / losers = biggest follower change over window; milestones = soonest projected round-number milestone.

window.description: Change period in days for gainers / losers. Defaults to the longest period with enough history.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1), e.g. US, BR, IN.

tools.name: instagram_usage
tools.description: Your usage this month. Free (0 credits).

instructions: Read-only public Instagram data. Pass a username (with or without @) or a post/reel URL. Each call spends API credits; meta.credits_remaining shows the balance.
